title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: How the election works
summary_full: October 3rd is another election day in Latvia. The country's democratic system is every bit as rigorous and complex as those in other countries, with polling stations opening both at home and across the globe, and this will be the 15th time a parliament, or Saeima, has been elected since the country won its independence in 1918.
